svg.aria-label: Projects. finale: One-knob mastering plugin (VST3) for music producers: C++ audio engine, loudness and tonal assistants, Catch2 tests and CI. Built Claude-first with a friend. (c++ · juce · ci). coastdown-analysis: Streamlit app that automates vehicle coastdown tests (NBR 10312). ~80% less analysis time. Code private. (published at SIMEA 2026). paper-trading-simulator: Full-stack Next.js and Postgres app: trade currencies and crypto with virtual cash at live quotes, a REST API for bots, a backtester and a leaderboard. Live demo on Vercel. (next.js · postgres · api). felipeeckert.github.io: React + Vite site with scroll-driven canvas motion. (web).
